question: Should the named LiteLLM interactive onboarding choice capture and use a proxy base URL before model selection, or should non-local LiteLLM users be routed to Custom Provider instead?
rationale: Both solutions are technically plausible, but the choice affects provider-owned onboarding UX, endpoint probing policy, model discovery behavior, and docs for remote LiteLLM proxies.

options.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
options.body: Have `litellm-api-key` ask for or confirm the proxy URL before model selection while preserving the existing localhost default and non-interactive `--custom-base-url` behavior.

options.title: Route To Custom Provider
options.body: Keep LiteLLM as a simple localhost/default-model setup path and update prompts/docs so remote LiteLLM users choose Custom Provider.

options.title: Defer To Catalog Policy
options.body: Leave this blocked until broader dynamic provider catalog and credentialed discovery policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
recommendation.body: Have `litellm-api-key` ask for or confirm the proxy URL before model selection while preserving the existing localhost default and non-interactive `--custom-base-url` behavior.
